__Steam/PlayStation/Xbox Achievements__

**America's Playground**

Complete Tax Evasion and The Most Sensational Game while being a Team Leader

**Rip and Tear**

Kill 10 Lesser Devils with a melee weapon

There is one fixed spawn for 2 Lesser Devils during Tax Evasion

From the Veribird, turn and face South.

Jump off the edge of the platform to the ground level.

Face South and follow the road to the end. Stop when you get to the bus and jump on top of it.

Face South and you should see a set of stairs in front of you.

Walk over and follow the stairs to the top.

At the top of the stairs, face East and use the Nuka Cola sign to get over to the next platform.

Face South and walk behind the circular structure and the Lesser Devils will spawn.

**The House Always Wins**

- Atlantic City Slot Machine 01
- Atlantic City Slot Machine 02
- World's Biggest Slot Machine
- Atlantic City Roulette Table

__New Locations__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_5912226058bb47199e8c7d07ab088d5b~mv2.jpg)

Gilman Lumber Mill is now a Responder Base.

Ingram Mansion has been closed up and will be re-opening in 2024 as a nightclub. The Mothman Eggs at that location have been removed.

The remaining locations have NPCs and a bit of lore but are there mostly to introduce new players to the different factions in Appalachia.

__New Daily Quests__

Fast Travel to the Forest region and a quest will pop up on your screen.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_2b2e52bad54f480f98b1497b2f9147a7~mv2.jpg)

Fast Travel to the Gilman Lumber Mill.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_dc3008a681e9401392c9897b6b6e4f1d~mv2.jpg)

Follow the map markers and speak to Lane.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_19528a3b0cd14c21a6d850554ac20431~mv2.jpg)

Lane will give you one of the below tasks to complete.

- Collect items to craft a Care Package and deliver it to a location nearby
- Collect meat from the Responder's traps and return it to Lane
- Collect artifacts from the Cult of the Mothman caves and return them to Lane

You will be given one of these three tasks to complete every time you return for the daily.

These quests are well-marked and can be completed quickly, using the map markers.

Rewards include:

- Caps
- Boiled water
- Fruit and vegetables
- Grenades
- Aid and
- Camp item plans.

__New and Updated Food Buffs__

*Overdrive stack has been fixed on the PTS

*Melee Damage food buffs will no longer stack on each other

*Yasmin's inventory has been updated - will update her guide and inventory list shortly

If you already knew the original 60-minute Melee Damage food buffs, then you will not need to re-learn the plan.

You will need to re-learn the 30-minute Melee Damage food buff recipes.

**Updated Melee Buffs**

The % damage figures below are base numbers. SIN and Magazines will still buff them like usual.

__30-minute buffs__

- **Light Yao Guai Ribs** +20% Melee Damage

**Recipe Location:** Learned when you pick up a piece of Yao Guai Meat. 

**Ingredients:**

- 2x Yao Guai Meat
- 2x Wood

- **Light Mutant Hound Chops** +20% Melee Damage

**Recipe Location:** Learned when you pick up a piece of Mutant Hound Meat 

**Ingredients:**

- 2x Mutant Hound Meat
- 2x Wood

- **Light Mutton Chops** +20% Melee Damage

**Recipe Location:** Learned when you pick up a piece of Sheepsquatch Meat 

**Ingredients:**

- 2x Sheepsquatch Meat
- 2x Wood

__30-minute buffs__

**Recipe Location:** Learned when you pick up a piece of Glowing Meat 

**Ingredients:**

__60-minute buffs__

- **Tasty Yao Guai Roast** +85% Melee Damage

**Recipe Location:** The plan can be purchased from Yasmin and Grandma Junko (camp allys). Can drop from Thrill of the Grill Pip-Boy daily and can be found at recipe plan spawn locations, etc.

**Ingredients:**

- 12x Yao Guai Meat
- 4x Pepper
- 8x Mutfruit
- 4x Boiled Water
- 6x Wood

**Recipe Location:** The plan can be purchased from Yasmin and Grandma Junko (camp allys). Can drop from Thrill of the Grill Pip-Boy daily and can be found at recipe plan spawn locations, etc.
